body: A road is rubbed out on the map, while six small figures remain beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper at the place where they waited. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: The count beneath the route in the rain

body: The board lists four vehicle numbers and no names. An erased fifth line still bears the pressure of a child’s small handwriting. The string has been retied since morning.
title: A tally without passengers in the rain

body: The sealed kit is tied to a towel marked for a passenger. The seat allocation has been crossed off, though the towel is still damp. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: Supplies for an empty seat in the rain

body: The loose page gives a route at odds with the one inked on the map. Someone has traced both with a finger stained from a lunch wrapper. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Two directions in one fold in the rain

body: The battery is taped to a torch beside a handwritten departure time. Its owner waited long enough to use up the spare. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: The lamp after closing in the rain

body: A badge and a band for counting arrivals are tied together. The band has an extra notch that never made it onto the badge. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: An unissued place in line in the rain

body: The jack bears fresh road grit and the wrench a strip of warning tape. The repair was abandoned beside a penciled clearance time. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Repair before the barrier in the rain

body: A frequency is scratched into the pencil’s paint. The radio’s own label names another channel, and the paper wrapped around it says to wait. The string has been retied since morning.
title: The second signal in the rain

body: A penciled household count ends at six. A red pen adds one name in the margin and then runs out before the line for a seat. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: One more household in the rain

body: The bag contains an unused lunch wrapper; the map is folded to a stop crossed out twice. A child wrote the original time on the strap. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Packed for the wrong stop in the rain
